description: This script performs code generation for internal Vulkan shaders in the ANGLE project, including creating C++ header and source files, and a GNI build file, based on shader variations and external shader files.

classes.name: CompileQueue
classes.description: Manages asynchronous compilation and preprocessing jobs for shaders, including thread management and error handling.

classes.name: CompileQueue.AppendPreprocessorOutput
classes.description: Handles asynchronous execution of shader preprocessor and appends output to files.

classes.name: CompileQueue.CompileToSPIRV
classes.description: Handles asynchronous compilation of shaders to SPIR-V format.

classes.name: ShaderAndVariations
classes.description: Represents a shader file along with its variation parameters and computes variation-related data.

methods.name: get_shader_id
methods.description: Returns a string ID for a shader based on its filename.

methods.name: get_output_path
methods.description: Returns the output path for a shader's generated SPIR-V file.

methods.name: get_shader_variations
methods.description: Reads a JSON variation file for a shader and returns flags and enums.

methods.name: get_variation_bits
methods.description: Calculates the number of bits needed for flags and enums.

methods.name: next_enum_variation
methods.description: Iterates through all enum variation combinations.

methods.name: cleanup_preprocessed_shader
methods.description: Removes excessive blank lines from shader preprocessor output.

methods.name: get_var_name
methods.description: Generates a variable name for a shader or variation.

methods.name: get_namespace_name
methods.description: Generates a namespace name based on shader filename.

methods.name: get_variation_table_name
methods.description: Generates a table name for shader variations.

methods.name: gen_shader_blob_entry
methods.description: Creates an entry for a shader blob array.

methods.name: gen_shader_include
methods.description: Generates an include directive for a shader.

methods.name: get_shader_table_h
methods.description: Generates the header for shader variation table.

methods.name: get_shader_table_cpp
methods.description: Generates the C++ source for shader variation table.

methods.name: get_get_function_h
methods.description: Generates the function declaration for getting a shader.

methods.name: get_get_function_cpp
methods.description: Generates the function implementation for retrieving a shader.

methods.name: get_destroy_call
methods.description: Generates code to destroy shader objects.

methods.name: shader_path
methods.description: Returns the relative path of a shader file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating shader code generation, compilation, and file creation.
